title: Dual Faced Cosmic Entity
description: Two blue-skinned female figures with golden eyes are merged into one being, divided by a bright white and blue lightning bolt running vertically through the center. Golden tears stream down both faces while they gaze forward with neutral expressions against a swirling cosmic background of yellow, gold, and deep purple patterns.
prompt: A surreal fantasy portrait of a single being with two blue-skinned female faces merged together, one with long dark braided hair, both with glowing golden eyes and golden tears streaming down their faces, a bright white and blue lightning bolt splitting them down the middle, intricate golden patterns on their necks and clothing, set against a swirling cosmic background of yellow, gold and purple energy with floating symbols, dramatic lighting, painterly style.
